# viya Provider

The Viya provider manages the configuration of a [SAS Viya](https://www.sas.com/en_us/software/viya.html) deployment through its REST APIs.

The provider authenticates against SAS Logon Manager in one of two ways:

- `client_id` and `client_secret`: the OAuth2 client credentials grant. This is the recommended way for automation.
- `access_token`: a token obtained out of band. It is not renewed when it expires.

A request that gets no response from SAS Viya within 60 seconds fails. With `TF_LOG=DEBUG`, the provider logs each request that it sends: method, path, status and duration. Request and response bodies are never logged.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    viya = {
      source = "jacoblamarche/viya"
    }
  }
}

# Credentials are best supplied through the environment:
#
#   export VIYA_CLIENT_ID=terraform
#   export VIYA_CLIENT_SECRET=...
provider "viya" {
  endpoint = "https://viya.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `access_token` (String, Sensitive) OAuth2 access token. It cannot be combined with `client_id` and `client_secret`. Can also be set with the `VIYA_ACCESS_TOKEN` environment variable.
- `client_id` (String) ID of an OAuth2 client registered in SAS Logon Manager. Can also be set with the `VIYA_CLIENT_ID` environment variable.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Secret of the OAuth2 client. Can also be set with the `VIYA_CLIENT_SECRET` environment variable.
- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the SAS Viya deployment, for example `https://viya.example.com`. It must use HTTPS, except for `localhost`. Can also be set with the `VIYA_ENDPOINT` environment variable.
